_note: THE TUTORIAL (src/game/courses/tutorial.ts builds it, src/game/tutorial.ts runs its steps; docs/PLAN_TUTORIAL.md, Milestones 633 and on). The owner, 2026-10-17: a run of its own, the player put somewhere that is not the range, every room passed only by doing its move, in this order: move forward, jump up a ledge, double jump up a ledge (then told they can mantle), a part only a double jump and a mantle reach, a part only a wall run gets past, DASH with a double jump across with walls you cannot run, two rooms with the ANAKIN in hand climbing up to shoot soldiers of 50 health, and last a superglide with a side bridge marked optional; out at the end into the firing range. It starts behind the range's right-hand gate and runs out up that bay (`out`, x across, facing +z), across the far end (turnZ to farZ), and back down the middle bay (`back`, facing -z) to its way out, the middle gate, between the gun stands and the hack stands, facing the dummies. One bay is 187 m to the city's edge (BR_Z less its half, 196), and the run is about twice that. Every number here was measured on the real controller (tools/checks/sk-tutorial.ts drives it through this geometry): the rooms before the ANAKIN unarmed, the gun put away (movement.json holsterBoost, 15% faster), the rest armed. Metres. A slick face (range.ts Solid.slick) takes no wall run and no climb, and a mantle still takes its top: every ledge a jump has to reach is slick, or a climb would take any wall up to 8 m. Fall below a pit's deck by fallBelow and you are back at its door.
_move: Room 1: forward to its far door, `length` metres.
_jump: Room 2: a slick ledge `height` up and `depth` deep across the bay, `at` metres in (room for a run at it). Measured unarmed: a walk does not get onto any slick ledge (0.8 to 5.2 m); one jump from 0.5 to 5 m out gets onto it from every distance from 1.4 m to 3.6 m, and onto none from 3.8 m.
_double: Room 3: the same, `height` up: one jump from any distance gets onto none at 3.8 m and over, a double jump onto 4.0 m at 63 of 72 timings (0.5 to 5 m out, the second jump 0.1 to 0.8 s after the first; 45 of 72 at 4.4 m, none at 5.2). The double jump ends in a mantle at this height, which the next room's step then names.
_mantle: Room 4: a step up onto a deck, the deck, a pit `pit` long, and a slick ledge whose top is `top` (absolute) and `depth` deep. Measured unarmed with the deck 1 m up: one jump at the edge does not get onto a 5.0 m top over a 4, 6 or 8 m pit; the double jump, 0.2 to 0.7 s after it, does, with the mantle (5.4 m: to 0.6 s). The room is `length` long so its ledge ends 2.5 m short of the next door's wall (Milestone 638): at 24 the ledge's far end was 0.5 m from that wall, narrower than a body (0.81 m), so from its top nobody could get down to the door under it (the owner's playtest, 2026-10-18). sk-tutorial's run end to end now walks every room into the next.
_wallRun: Room 5: a step up, the deck, the pit `pit` long beside the lit wall (the bay's outer wall), the landing deck `landing` long and the floor on to the turn. Measured unarmed over a 1 m deck to its fall line: one jump 13.2 m, the double jump at its best 25.7 m (0.8 s), a wall run along the wall 45.2 m. 32 m is a quarter past the double jump's best and 13 m inside the run's.
_dash: Room 6, the first of the way back: the hacks come on, your move hack DASH (hacks.json dash: the eye along the look 26 m, or to a wall less 1.5 body radii, momentum kept). A step up, the deck, the pit `pit` long, and a slick ledge `top` (absolute) and `depth` deep; the room's side walls are slick from its door to its end. The dash stops at the ledge's face whatever it was aimed at, so it is the height you dash from that counts: a dash from a jump (feet at most 1.4 m over the deck) leaves you at the face with its top out of a mantle's reach, a dash from a double jump (2.7 m) leaves you a mantle from the top. Measured unarmed: every double jump then dash tried lands, and the dash then the double jump at most timings; every jump and dash looking level falls in, and the dash alone. Looking a few degrees up, a jump and dash goes over the ledge's top instead of into its face, as the dash does anywhere: that is the dash learned too. A fall here gives the dash back at once.
_high: Room 7, the ANAKIN in your hands from here: a slick platform `height` up and `depth` deep across the bay `at` metres in (armed: one jump onto none from 3.8 m, the double jump onto 4.0 m at 63 of 72 timings, as unarmed), and soldiers of `health` (a hit's damage off it, no shield) on the floor beyond, `ahead` metres past the platform's far edge, up only once you are on it.
_climb: Room 8: a wall `height` up and `depth` thick across the bay `at` metres in, not slick: a climb from a sprint gets onto a wall up to 8 m from any approach (armed, measured), and nothing else onto 6 m. Soldiers of the same health beyond it, up once you are on top.
_superglide: Room 9, last: `runUp` metres of floor to a ledge `ledge` high and `top` deep across the superglide lane (the bay but its last `bridgeW` metres, behind a slick wall `wall` thick), the gap, a landing deck at the ledge's height `landing` long across the whole bay. The other lane is the optional way: `stairs` steps up to the ledge's height and a bridge along it over the pit to the landing deck. reach.json superglide is measured off this ledge (tools/checks/reach.ts, armed): `without` the furthest any approach gets past the ledge's far edge without a superglide before its feet are fallBelow under it, `carry` the least a superglide alone gets from any approach; the gap is midway between `without` times `over` and `carry` times `under`. At 3.8 m no jump lands on the top without a mantle, and every approach mantles and superglides with the real input (jump, then crouch a frame later, in the mantle's last 0.15 s). The lane's side walls are slick.
_out: The way out: the middle gate in the range's back wall (range.ts COURSE_GATE_C, under its lintel), its door `doorH` high, shut until the last room is done or passed by the bridge.
